s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive orbital swelling with vision deterioration and proptosis
salient_findings: Left fronto-orbital swelling of 10 years’ duration
Progressive deterioration of vision in the left eye
Proptosis with inferior and medial displacement of the left globe
Heterogeneous enhancing mass in the left orbital roof on MRI
key_facts: 35-year-old woman
Left fronto-orbital swelling for 10 years
Progressive vision deterioration in the left eye over 1.5 years
Proptosis became more pronounced over the past month
Left globe displaced inferiorly and medially
No history of endocrine abnormalities
Heterogeneous enhancing mass in the left orbital roof on MRI
Expansive lytic bony lesion involving the superior and lateral walls of the orbit on CT scan

shortlist.label: Orbital meningioma
shortlist.why_kept: Heterogeneous enhancing mass in the left orbital roof and proptosis

shortlist.label: Fibrous dysplasia
shortlist.why_kept: Expansive lytic bony lesion involving the superior and lateral walls of the orbit

shortlist.label: Sphenoid wing meningioma

shortlist.label: Orbital osteoma

shortlist.label: Langerhans cell histiocytosis
shortlist.why_kept: Possibility of a lytic bony lesion with soft tissue component, although less common in adults

trace.fact: Left fronto-orbital swelling of 10 years’ duration

rule_in.why: it is commonly associated with long-standing swelling

rule_out.why: it typically has a shorter duration

trace.fact: Progressive deterioration of vision in the left eye

rule_out.why: it is typically a benign tumor with slow growth and less likely to cause progressive deterioration of vision

trace.fact: Proptosis with inferior and medial displacement of the left globe

rule_in.why: it typically causes proptosis with inferior and medial displacement

rule_out.why: proptosis with inferior and medial displacement is less typical

trace.fact: Heterogeneous enhancing mass in the left orbital roof on MRI

rule_in.why: it is more common in women
it is a condition known for long-standing bony swelling

trace.fact: Progressive vision deterioration in the left eye over 1.5 years

rule_in.why: it often causes progressive vision loss

rule_out.why: it is typically a benign and slow-growing tumor that does not usually cause progressive vision deterioration

trace.fact: Proptosis became more pronounced over the past month

rule_in.why: it is most directly associated with progressive proptosis

rule_out.why: progression is compatible with all candidates
